notes: 0.3.2：删空自己托盘菜单的脚本不再弹空菜单——点它改为前置它的主窗口（列表右键、齿轮格、菜单栏、托盘「运行中」四条入口一致）；官方脚本下载验真收敛为只认头部 @name + @version（与你改脚本头部后的清单一致才装，不加哈希、不比大小）；MCP 端 initialize 回带 instructions 闭环说明，运行失败回带 next 指明下一步工具；AI 文件边界拒 UNC 与目录联接伪装。
notes_en: 0.3.2: a script that emptied its own tray menu no longer pops an empty popup - clicking it now brings its window to the front (same guard on row menu, gear cell, menu bar and tray Running). Official downloads are verified by header @name + @version only: no hashing, no size tolerance. The MCP endpoint returns initialize.instructions describing the edit-check-validate-run-read-fix loop, and failed runs carry a next hint naming the next tool. The AI file boundary now rejects UNC paths and reparse-point (junction/symlink) smuggling.
